overview_description.description:
Bonsai is an online freelancing platform that helps companies and independent talent work better together. It offers contracts written by well-recognized attorneys, smart invoices, and integrated payment solutions.

The platform enables companies that hire freelancers easily manage their external workforce. It also helps freelancers transform their external talent into a source of income.

Bonsai was launched in 2015 and is based in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: All-in-one business platform for creative agencies to manage projects, time, resources, and billing.

product.name: Client Management
product.description: A system to manage leads, clients, and automate client workflows including CRM, deals, estimates, proposals, contracts, retainers, forms, and a client portal.

product.name: Project Management
product.description: Tools to organize, monitor, and deliver projects on time and budget, including task management, Gantt charts, time tracking, budgets, timesheets, resource planning, and reporting.

product.name: Financial Management
product.description: Features to monitor revenue, automate billing with recurring payments and retainers, and manage invoicing, payments, expenses, rate cards, budgeting, and bookkeeping.

product.name: Automations
product.description: Automated workflows to save time by reducing manual tasks across client management, project delivery, and billing processes.

product.name: Reporting
product.description: Tools to generate detailed reports and dashboards for key performance indicators, financials, project status, and resource utilization.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Capabilities to connect Bonsai with external tools and software to extend functionality and streamline workflows.
